name: Megha Engineering and Infrastructures Limited
summary: A large Hyderabad-based infrastructure company working on highways, irrigation, water supply and energy projects.
about: MEIL began in 1989 as a small pipe-making business and grew into one of India's biggest privately held infrastructure companies. It is best known for enormous irrigation projects, but it also builds highway packages, drinking water systems, power plants and oil and gas infrastructure, and takes on expressway stretches as part of the package-based system NHAI uses for long roads.
facts: Started in 1989 making pipes, and grew into a major infrastructure builder.
Best known for very large irrigation and water supply projects.
Also builds highway and expressway packages.
